description: Cs₂NaGaP₂ is alpha Pu-derived structured and crystallizes in the orthorhombic Ibam space group. Cs is bonded in a 9-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Ga, and five equivalent P atoms. Both Cs-Na bond lengths are 3.63 Å. Both Cs-Ga bond lengths are 3.70 Å. There are a spread of Cs-P bond distances ranging from 3.47-4.04 Å. Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to four equivalent Cs and four equivalent P atoms. All Na-P bond lengths are 2.95 Å. Ga is bonded to four equivalent Cs and four equivalent P atoms to form distorted face-sharing GaCs₄P₄ tetrahedra. All Ga-P bond lengths are 2.49 Å. P is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to five equivalent Cs, two equivalent Na, and two equivalent Ga atoms.
